name: Issho ni Gohan.
source: In order to take over the restaurant her family owns in the countryside the protagonist 'Mugibata Akane' enrolls into the 'Hanarenzaku Cooking University'. Not being able to live on her meager allowance she goes out in the city to look for a part-time job. She looks so hard she's at the point of collapsing, but then a certain person saves her on one condition. That condition is that she must become the landlady of the student apartment building the 'Meshikessou'. Will she be able to properly perform the duties? And why are the boarders all so individual!
translation: 为了接手乡下老家的餐馆，主角麦畑茜考入了花连作料理大学。微薄的生活费让她难以维持生计，于是她到城里找工作。她找得几乎要倒下了，就在这时一个人在某个条件下救了她。条件是她必须成为学生公寓"饭结庄"的管理员。她能胜任这份工作吗？而且，为什么住户们都这么有个性！
